title: Two days in Da Nang
summary: My Khe and An Thuong on the first day. Son Tra and the Marble Mountains on the second, with Hội An still an easy ride if the hills are enough.

days.title: Day 1 — Beach and An Thuong
days.body: The Cham Museum on the river, My Khe in the morning, mì Quảng for lunch, and An Thuong after dark.

days.title: Day 2 — Peninsula and the hills
days.body: Linh Ung on Son Tra, then Thủy Sơn at the Marble Mountains on the road toward Hội An.

stops.name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
stops.note: Give an hour to the Cham stone on the Han before the beach.

approach.note: The museum is on the Han, a walk from the river side.

stops.name: My Khe Beach
stops.note: Swim inside the buoy line while rescuers are on duty.

approach.note: From the river side, cross the Han by car or Grab.

stops.name: An Thuong
stops.note: After dark, walk inland from the beach road into the lanes.

approach.note: Walk in from the beach road after the swim.

stops.name: Linh Ung Pagoda, Son Tra
stops.note: Ride to Linh Ung on Son Tra and walk the terrace.

approach.note: By car or Grab to Bai But, about 10 km northeast of the center.

stops.name: Marble Mountains
stops.note: Climb Thủy Sơn, about 15 minutes from the center.
